title: an array of started Promises bound to a name is consumed by awaiting the ambient Promise.all
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Promise Semantics': 'Authored `.sm` code MUST consume Promise instances only through `await`.' 'Calls to Promise instance `.then()`, `.catch()`, or `.finally()` MUST be compile errors.' docs/DECISIONS.md (Locked, Concurrency) requires every started Promise to be consumed with await. Storing started Promises in an array and handing the array to `Promise.all` is the ordinary concurrent spelling; the inline form `await Promise.all([work(), work()])` was already accepted, and binding the array one line earlier must not change the answer. The refusal direction is the sibling case below.
